purpose: Minimal SGG torii app-icon and favicon candidate optimized for recognition at 16px
character_usage_reason: This is a reusable brand and UI icon whose sole subject is the torii mark; no GODS or OTOMO character is required.

image_generation.tool: GPT Image via Codex built-in image generation

reference_input.role: SGG brand reference for the high-level torii identity only; stars, palette, outlines, proportions, and ornament were explicitly excluded from the final design
reference_input.rights_scope: Reference input for a project-specific GPT Image reconstruction; source pixels are not used as the production asset

image_generation.substantive_reconstruction: Rebuilt the supplied red-and-gold torii-and-seven-stars mark as a new favicon-specific composition: one large front-facing geometric torii in vivid turquoise, broad negative openings, very thick beams and pillars, no stars, no ornament, and a fully opaque white-to-near-white square background. A second GPT Image revision removed the initial dark outer corners and flattened the result for maximum small-size contrast.
prompt_set: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: square app icon and favicon master, intended to remain recognizable at 16x16 px. Use sgg-mark.png as a brand-motif reference only; preserve the unmistakable high-level identity of a Japanese torii gate, but create a substantively new, purpose-built minimal favicon composition. Do not reproduce the reference's stars, colors, highlights, outlines, proportions, or ornamental details. Create one clean rounded-square app icon with a single bold torii gate silhouette centered and very large. Use a fully opaque solid pure-white to extremely pale neutral-gray backdrop. Render exactly one front-facing, perfectly symmetrical, simplified torii with an emphatic gently upturned top lintel, a thick secondary crossbeam, and two very thick vertical pillars in vivid saturated turquoise blue, approximately #00AFC4. Keep negative openings broad and simple so the gate reads clearly at 16 px. Ultra-minimal flat vector-like raster icon, crisp geometric edges, square 1:1, torii occupying roughly 78-84% of the canvas, no text, no stars, no other object, no decoration, no shadow, glow, gradient, texture, bevel, 3D, transparency, scenery, watermark, or outline.

Edit fav-03.png while keeping the existing torii composition, scale, symmetry, and simplified silhouette. Replace every black or dark pixel in all four outer corners with the same opaque near-white background used behind the torii. Remove visible shadow, glow, gradient, texture, bevel, blur, and lighting variation. Keep exactly one centered, front-facing, vivid-turquoise torii with thick pillars and beams, broad negative openings, no stars, no text, no other symbols or decoration, and an opaque 1:1 background.

visual_qa.full_size: PASS: one large turquoise torii on an opaque white-to-near-white square background; no stars, text, characters, watermark, scenery, or additional subject.
visual_qa.final_crop: PASS: the torii is centered, front-facing, symmetric, and contained within an even favicon safe area; all four canvas corners are near-white rather than black or transparent.
visual_qa.favicon_16px: PASS: a Lanczos 16x16 downsample retains the upturned top beam, secondary crossbeam, two thick pillars, and broad central opening as an immediately legible torii silhouette.
visual_qa.contrast: PASS: sampled 16px background corners remain approximately #FEFEFE while core torii pixels remain saturated turquoise; no fine decorative detail is required for recognition.
visual_qa.reference_similarity: PASS: the output preserves only the high-level torii identity and materially changes the palette, construction, proportions, element count, spacing, and visual treatment; all seven stars and source ornament are removed.
